thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging alert - p99 decode latency spike detected in us-west-2 (streaming). auto-paging enabled.

maya: oncall here, I'm seeing p99 ~3200ms on streaming decode endpoints, p95 around 800-900ms.

devin: confirming, dashboards show a sudden jump ~10m ago. staging looks clean, only prod impacted.

sofia: any recent infra/kernel rollouts in that region?

liam: yep we pushed an infra kernel + TRT/FlashAttn tweak ~12m ago. Deploy details: `inference-kernel v2.3.1` by liam.

deploy-bot: deploy completed by liam at 6778900670: inference-kernel v2.3.1 (commit abcdef1).

jessica: logs show increased KV cache evictions around the same time, and tail stalls on decode. sample log snippet:```
[2026-03-15T18:34:12Z] decode: kv_cache_evictions=1243 tail_latency_ms=3100 model=redwood-small trt_variant=trt8-flashattn
[2026-03-15T18:34:13Z] decode: enqueue_delay_ms=5 decode_ms=2950
```

maya: immediate mitigation options: 1) route streaming traffic to fallback pool; 2) rollback kernel to v2.3.0; 3) enable extra caching layer.

devin: i'm starting a routing change to fallback pool to see impact first (less risky).

jessica: go for it. also capture heap/kv stats before/after.

sofia: migration command if needed:```
redwoodctl route update --route streaming --to dedicated-fallback-usw2 --region us-west-2 --dry-run=false
```

liam: i'm prepping a kernel rollback too in case routing doesn't fully fix it. rollback command:```
redwoodctl infra rollback kernel --cluster inference-usw2 --to-tag v2.3.0 --reason "latency spike p99"
```

opsbot: rollback job queued (id 9876). estimated rollout 3-6 minutes.

devin: routing change applied. watching metrics...

maya: update: 90s after reroute p99 dropped from 3200ms -> 600ms, p95 back to ~180ms. partial relief, but still watching for residual spikes. :eyes: 

pm-erin: pm note - customer impact: ACME and FinSafe reported degraded sessions. ACME support: 12 degraded sessions, one escalation ticket opened. pinged support to notify customers of mitigation steps.

jessica: collected traces & heap profiles uploaded to S3 at `s3://redwood-traces/6778901234/` (samples + kv eviction histograms).

liam: rollback completed on canary nodes; progressing cluster-wide. confirming final state...

opsbot: rollback job 9876 status: success on all nodes (completed at 6778901200).

maya: after rollback p99 steady ~220ms, p95 ~140ms - within SLOs. closing immediate paging.

sofia: initial hypothesis: kernel compilepath change in v2.3.1 interacts poorly with TRT8 flash-attn variant — causes KV cache eviction churn and decode tail spikes. suspect compiler/linker flags introduced in the build.

jessica: note: observed `-fuse-ld=gold` and `-O3 -funroll-loops` present in v2.3.1 build flags. will attach build.log to the ticket.

liam: next actions I'm taking: 1) bisect kernel commits between v2.3.0->v2.3.1 2) reproduce with trt8+flashattn locally 3) add safety gate to deployment pipeline to block kernel/compile changes without a canary workload run.

devin: i'll open incident ticket and assign to eng-runtime + eng-ml for RCA. saving all traces and timelines.

pm-erin: thanks team. support will follow up with customers; we'll include ETA for RCA in the ticket.

maya: handing off to eng-sre ops for monitoring and RCA. oncall remains available for any regression alerts. I'll add follow-up actions in the incident tracker. :white_check_mark:

sofia: tagging: @eng-runtime @eng-ml — please prioritize reproducer and bisect. we should consider a temporary deploy-block for kernel flags until we confirm compatibility.

jessica: created ticket IR-2026-451 with all artifacts and timeline. linking to postmortem template.

maya: closing thread for active paging, leaving open for RCA updates.
